assistant|moncayo_activities: The Natural Park of the Moncayo mountain offers hiking, wildlife watching, camping, skiing in winter, mountain biking, cultural visits, picnicking, and rock climbing
assistant|moncayo_wildlife: The Moncayo park is home to eagles, vultures, deer, wild boars and other wildlife species
assistant|moncayo_monuments: The Moncayo park contains the Monastery of Veruela and the Castle of Trasmoz as historical monuments
assistant|moncayo_hiking_recommendation: Hiking is recommended as a must-try activity in the Natural Park of the Moncayo mountain
assistant|gr90_trail_details: The GR-90 is a circular hiking trail of approximately 36 kilometers taking two to three days to complete, passing through several small towns and villages
assistant|gr90_trail_highlights: Highlights of the GR-90 include the summit of Moncayo mountain (the park's highest peak), the Fuenfría waterfall, meadows, forests, and rock formations
assistant|moncayo_best_season: Spring and autumn are the best seasons for hiking in the Moncayo park; summer is hot and crowded, winter brings snow
assistant|moncayo_summer_advice: For summer hiking in Moncayo, avoid the hottest hours of the day and drink plenty of water
assistant|moncayo_accommodation_options: Accommodation near the Moncayo park includes rural cottages, camping sites, guesthouses and hotels in Tarazona, Veruela, and Borja, and hostels
assistant|moncayo_booking_advice: For finding rural cottages near Moncayo, search booking.com, Airbnb, or TripAdvisor, and book in advance especially in peak season
